answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 45747 Country: Pakistan Title: Cleanliness Question: I am very worried about one thing whenever I wear shalwar qamees after sometime I see some spot on my shalwar whose colour almost resembles that of feces though I wash that part properly. Now I am not sure whether it is dirt due to extreme sweating (hot weather here). I often have to pray out somewhere. Plus if wash it the stain doesn`t go away. So in this case can I do my salah? Can you help me in this matter? Answer ID: 45747 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 991/766/B=1434) It is enough to wash the impurity, it is not necessary to remove its colour or mark. If you washed away the impurity, the shalwar and qamis shall turn pure though the mark or colour remains. It is not necessary to remove the mark in order to get purity. You may offer salah with the mark too. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
